# Upstream references

Reference implementation: https://github.com/hkust-zhiyao/RTL-Timer

Inspected upstream revision during planning: `206ff4078368c251d2fafaffcc648282c68316f1`.

The fetch command retrieves selected reference scripts and libraries at this revision. They remain ignored generated inputs. Adaptations in our Python code are attributed in `docs/attribution.md`, with the upstream BSD notice retained in `docs/RTL-Timer-LICENSE.txt`. External assets retain their original notices; library licensing is separate from code licensing.
